candidates.title: Prepare research graphs from CSV data

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare graphs from CSV data for use in research articles.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want it to be able to make graphs that can be used in research articles

ease.reason: A student can test supplied CSV samples and graph drafts, but the post gives no plotting requirements or implementation reference.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: researchers may value help preparing publication graphs; this Show HN post establishes no service buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can turn sample CSV columns into a reviewed graph; research formatting and large-file behavior remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A repeatable draft graph can be generated from a supplied file, but a researcher must check data, labels and publication suitability.

evidence.reason: The post identifies CSV handling and research-article graphs, but gives no required formats, repeated demand or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (23/5 = 4.6). A narrow CSV-to-draft-graph experiment is conceivable, but the post gives little task detail and no implementation evidence.
